island.name: Making plans & socializing
island.description: Inviting people out, agreeing on a time and place, cancelling and rescheduling.

sentences.en: What are you doing this evening?
sentences.ro: Ce faci diseară?

sentences.en: Do you want to go out for a beer?
sentences.ro: Vrei să ieșim la o bere?
sentences.note: "A ieși la o bere" is the standard invitation for a drink.

sentences.en: Let's meet in front of the cinema.
sentences.ro: Hai să ne vedem în fața cinematografului.

sentences.en: What time works for you?
sentences.ro: La ce oră îți convine?
sentences.note: "Îți convine" = it suits you — very common when agreeing on a time.

sentences.en: Seven o'clock is perfect for me.
sentences.ro: La șapte e perfect pentru mine.

sentences.en: I can't tonight, I'm busy.
sentences.ro: Nu pot diseară, sunt ocupat.

sentences.en: Can we do it another time?
sentences.ro: Putem să ne vedem altă dată?

sentences.en: I'm sorry, something came up.
sentences.ro: Îmi pare rău, mi-a apărut ceva.

sentences.en: Come to my place, I'll cook something.
sentences.ro: Vino la mine, gătesc eu ceva.

sentences.en: Can I bring a friend along?
sentences.ro: Pot să vin cu un prieten?

sentences.en: There's a party at Andrei's on Friday.
sentences.ro: Vineri e o petrecere la Andrei.

sentences.en: I'll be there around nine.
sentences.ro: Ajung pe la nouă.
sentences.note: "Pe la" + time = around that time, roughly.

sentences.en: Text me when you leave.
sentences.ro: Dă-mi un mesaj când pleci.

sentences.en: I'm already on my way.
sentences.ro: Sunt deja pe drum.

sentences.en: We haven't seen each other in ages.
sentences.ro: Nu ne-am mai văzut de o veșnicie.

sentences.en: It was really nice, thanks for the invitation.
sentences.ro: A fost foarte plăcut, mersi de invitație.
sentences.note: "Mersi" is the casual thanks between friends.

sentences.en: Shall we get the next round?
sentences.ro: Mai luăm un rând?
sentences.note: "Un rând" is a round of drinks.

sentences.en: I have to go, it's getting late.
sentences.ro: Trebuie să plec, se face târziu.

sentences.en: Let me know if the plan changes.
sentences.ro: Spune-mi dacă se schimbă planul.

sentences.en: See you on Sunday then!
sentences.ro: Atunci ne vedem duminică!
